completeness: Council coverage is measured against Ireland's 31 statutory local authorities. Document-level completeness still requires a verified meeting-calendar denominator per council.
recall: Document-type recall is unmeasured. Publication uses deterministic filename/header rules; agenda filenames are excluded even when their text quotes prior minutes.
caveat: All text is machine extracted. source_status=ocr_winocr carries OCR risk; committee and municipal-district minutes remain distinct from plenary council minutes.
